Bus Articulated Bellows

Flexible bellows enclosures for articulated buses, specified around the articulation joint, body interfaces and passenger passage.

Product overview

Bus articulated bellows enclose the moving joint between bus sections. They must accommodate steering articulation and road-induced movement while fitting the body contours. The bellows enclosure should not be confused with the structural articulation joint, turntable or steering-control system.

Applications

Articulated city buses and other multi-section passenger buses. Replacement inquiries should identify the bus model, articulation layout and existing attachment profiles.

Technical information to confirm

  • Maximum steering articulation and vertical movement
  • Roof, sidewall and floor attachment contours
  • Inner and outer bellows scope where applicable
  • Road splash, sunlight, cleaning and project fire-performance requirements

Inspection and acceptance

Check contour fit, attachment dimensions, fold clearance and possible interference around the articulation joint. Agree movement and water-ingress checks with the bus integrator; component inspection does not replace vehicle approval.

Material selection, test methods and any applicable fire, smoke or vehicle requirements must be confirmed for the project. No certification or interchangeability is implied by this listing.

Packaging and shipping

Confirm packed dimensions, support points and storage limits after drawing review. Protect flexible folds from crushing and attachment profiles from distortion. Provide the destination, handling constraints and requested delivery terms for the shipping proposal.

Request a technical quotation

Send drawings, vehicle type, operating conditions, quantity and required delivery date to amy@railwheel.com. Amy Sun will coordinate a scope and feasibility review before quotation.

Product photography for this range is being prepared. Please request model-specific images and drawings when making an inquiry.

Frequently asked question

Can railway gangway bellows be used on a bus?

They are not interchangeable by default. Bus steering angles, body contours, attachments and approval requirements differ and need a vehicle-specific design review.
